title: bridge: RQ-DRAIN2-PH-09
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-DRAIN2-PH-09` (pool: devin), single commit on base `e78f74b1f`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# BRIDGE_NOTES — RQ-DRAIN2-PH-09

Bridge rework of conflicting PRs onto current main. Base: worktree HEAD
`e78f74b1f7e1fbd22279fe047a1b378377ede0d3` (master at worktree creation;
`origin/master` advanced to `da6ba9de8`, +37 bridge commits, during the
session — integration is left to publish.sh/sweep). All changes are
uncommitted in this worktree; no commit, push, tag, publish, or PR lifecycle
action was performed. `origin` push URL is `no_push`; publishing is owned by
`publish.sh`, PR close/merge by sweep jobs.

## Per-PR disposition

- `REWORKS_PR: 3500` — reworked. Most Fleet HTTP/OpenAPI surface was already on
  main; ported the remaining unique intent: Fleet HTTP contract references in
  `AGENTS.md`/`docs/llms.txt`, comms-bus priority wording ("Priority is a
  routing attribute, not authority; it does not establish identity") with its
  pinned test update, help/completions entries, and regenerated `docs/cli.md`.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3489` — reworked. Ported mac dispatcher/restock empty-run
  suppression and queue-priority behavior: cross-lane priority buckets,
  repo/size/path tie-breaking, per-repo serialization for `RQ-FIX-MAIN-*`,
  process-snapshot/launch-grace protections, serialized publishing handoffs,
  empty-run suppression keyed on repo+base SHA+prompt hash (failures/auth
  failures still retry), and `skipped_empty` metrics — across
  `contrib/mac/dispatchd.py`, `restock.py`, `launch_precheck.py`,
  `contrib/mac/README.md`, plus `test_empty_gate.py`, expanded
  `test_dispatchd.py`, and a `test_launch_precheck.py` upkeep case.
- `PR 3479 SUPERSEDED` — literal path handling plus `--before`/`--limit`
  pagination, full-SHA validation, and `nextBefore` continuation are already on
  main in `src/cli/fleet-path-history.ts`; covered by
  `fleet-path-history-literal-cli-04-spq1`, `fleet-path-history-cli`, and
  `fleet-path-history` tests (all pass). Nothing unique to port.
- `PR 3474 SUPERSEDED` — chief-of-staff approval/draft API is already on main:
  `src/core/cos/drafts.ts`, `src/core/cos/worker.ts`,
  `src/core/verse/fleet-cos-api.ts` (approval route covered by
  `verse-fleet-cos-api.test.ts`), `src/cli/fleet-cos-work.ts`,
  `src/mcp/fleet-job-current.ts`, plus COS web UI and draft tests
  (`cos-drafts.test.ts`, `fleet-comms-status-api-22`, web draft card/model
  tests). The PR's two extra draft-list test files have equivalent coverage on
  main; no unique behavior to port.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3465` — reworked. Ported explicit agent checkpoints as an
  opt-in feature (inert unless `PHANTOM_CHECKPOINTS=1`): private bounded
  `CheckpointStore` under `~/.phantom/checkpoints` (Zod-validated,
  private-path + stable-read + atomic-write, 2 MiB cap),
  `phantom_checkpoint` reserved sole-tool-call, evidence refs downgraded to
  hypotheses when uncited, resume rebuilds context from checkpoint + live git
  state (refuses on git failure), ordinary memory disabled in checkpoint mode,
  and offline `phm eval checkpoints --file` replay comparison
  (`src/core/local-eval/checkpoint-comparison.ts`, no model/tool calls).
  New: `src/core/run/checkpoints.ts`, `src/cli/eval-checkpoints.ts`,
  `docs/CHECKPOINTS.md`, `test/agent-checkpoints.test.ts`,
  `test/checkpoint-comparison.test.ts`; wired through `agent-loop.ts`,
  `eval.ts`, `help.ts`, `completions.ts`, `docs/README.md`, and the real-IO
  lane membership list.
- `PR 3461 SUPERSEDED` — object-form API pool support is already on main in
  `src/cli/fleet-api-pools.ts` with `test/fleet-api-pools-object.test.ts`
  coverage (passes). The PR's unrelated mac/CI/OpenAPI hunks were already
  present or not needed; nothing unique to port.

## Commands run and results

- `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`: blocked — sandbox denies `~/.config/gh`. PR refs
  and diffs were fetched directly from GitHub via git (auth through
  `gh auth git-credential`; no token values printed or stored).
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` (foreground, once): PASS file selection,
  PASS `tsc --noEmit`, PASS web typecheck skipped (no `src/web-ui/` changes),
  PASS realio lane lint, PASS verse sync-I/O lint, PASS verify dedupe.
  ESLint skipped locally: `node_modules/eslint/lib/cli.js` absent in this
  worktree; Merge Gate CI lints.
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS, 0 errors.
- `node scripts/generate-cli-docs.mjs`: regenerated `docs/cli.md` (fixed
  observability-topic ordering drift from new eval/checkpoint entries).
- `npx vitest run` targeted batch (temp HOME): 10 files, 81 tests — all pass:
  `fleet-api-pools`, `fleet-api-pools-object`, `fleet-path-history-cli`,
  `fleet-path-history-literal-cli-04-spq1`, `fleet-path-history`,
  `verse-fleet-cos-api`, `cos-drafts`, `comm-bus-priority-filter-31b2`,
  `agent-checkpoints`, `checkpoint-comparison`.
- Earlier checkpoint-focused runs: checkpoint + comparison suites green
  (42/42 and 9/9 across the new/affected files).
- Python (`contrib/mac`, unittest): `test_dispatchd` 57 pass;
  `test_empty_gate` 6 pass; `test_launch_precheck` 3 pass; restock/batching/
  concurrency/route-hysteresis/loadgate batch 86 pass. Full discover: 388
  tests, 35 errors — all environmental in files untouched by this change
  (`test_integrated_merge.py`, `test_release_autorun.py`): sandbox blocks
  `/bin/ps` (`EPERM`) and `release-autorun.sh` subprocess timeouts. No
  failure touches dispatchd/restock/launch_precheck.
- `npm run build`: PASS end-to-end. Notes: (a) a stale incremental
  `tsBuildInfoFile` (written by verify-changed's earlier `tsc --noEmit`) made
  the first emit skip unchanged files — fixed by removing
  `node_modules/.cache/phantom-backend.tsbuildinfo` and recompiling;
  (b) the release scripts require a node toolchain with npm under
  `lib/node_modules` — Homebrew node 26.9.0 splits npm to the prefix, so the
  build was re-run with the hermes node v22.22.3 toolchain (satisfies
  `engines >=22.15.0`); (c) `build-release-dependency-inventory.mjs` spawns a
  sandboxed `npm pack --dry-run` under a hardcoded 180 s timeout — the first
  attempt exceeded it while host load was ~62 on 18 cores and exited with
  empty stderr; a retry once load dipped passed (14,997-file report), and
  `build-identity` wrote `dist/build-identity.json`. All steps green; none of
  these issues touch files in this diff.

## Upstream drift note

`origin/master` advanced 37 commits during the session. Overlap with this
diff: `contrib/mac/restock.py` (upstream `ranked_records` repo-ranking
reorders the same candidate loop my empty-gate sits inside — semantically
compatible, gate is order-agnostic, but the loop header line changed so a
merge needs semantic resolution), `src/cli/comms-bus.ts` (upstream added
`comms bus group` subcommands; my one-line priority-wording flip is in a
different HELP region — should auto-merge), plus churn-only overlaps in
`help.ts`, `completions.ts`, `llms.txt`, `docs/README.md`, `docs/cli.md`,
`AGENTS.md`. No upstream commits touched `dispatchd.py`,
`launch_precheck.py`, or `agent-loop.ts`. Left unmerged per the no-commit
boundary; publish.sh/sweep own integration.

## Known limitations / notes

- `test/m264.local-context.test.ts` shows pre-existing import timeouts for
  `src/core/run/sandboxed-engine.ts` (which transitively imports the modified
  `agent-loop.ts`); checkpoint and agent-loop suites pass independently. This
  is import-overhead/environmental, not a regression — flagged for CI.
- ESLint could not run locally (package absent); lane lints and tsc passed.
- Checkpoint feature is fully inert without `PHANTOM_CHECKPOINTS=1`; no
  security control was weakened. Private-file helpers, Zod validation, and
  atomic writes follow existing repo patterns.
- `contrib/mac` changes require the normal Security re-pin before any live
  `bin/` install; no install was performed.

## Net LOC

- Tracked modifications: 17 files, +273 / −43 (net +230).
- New files: 7 files, 823 lines.
- Total: ~+1,053 net lines across 24 files.
</details>

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Agents can save and resume evidence-linked checkpoints, rebuilding their working context from fresh repository state.
  * Added an opt-in checkpoint comparison command for evaluating context retention and token estimates from fixture files.
  * Empty successful maintenance attempts are skipped on the same repository base; matching prompts are suppressed for 24 hours. Skips are reported separately from precheck skips.

* **Documentation**
  * Expanded guides and CLI help for checkpoints, Fleet HTTP routes, and chief-of-staff commands.
  * Added checkpoint and empty-attempt behavior to relevant documentation.
